label: ex:confinement-category-atomic-chain
title: The atomic chain in $\mathbf{Conf}$
html: The chain \mathrm{quark} \xrightarrow{\downarrow_1} \mathrm{nucleon} \xrightarrow{\downarrow_2} \mathrm{atom} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{dress}} \mathrm{neutral\ atom} \xrightarrow{\downarrow_3} \mathrm{molecule} is a composite morphism in \mathbf{Conf} taking free quarks to a bonded molecule by successive foldings and one dressing. Each arrow preserves or extends the Markov trace.
heading: Example
